seoTitle: How to Remove a Credit Card From PayPal (Fix Error)
metaDescription: Learn how to delete a card from PayPal and fix the "We can't remove this card right now" error caused by subscriptions or pending payments.
intro: Trying to delete a card from PayPal only to hit the 'We can't remove this card right now' message is a common frustration. This guide explains why PayPal blocks card removal in certain situations and walks through the fixes needed to finally delete it.

steps.heading: Try the standard card removal process
steps.body: Go to your PayPal wallet, select the card you want to delete, and choose the remove option.

steps.heading: Understand why removal gets blocked
steps.body: PayPal often blocks card removal when the card is tied to an active subscription, a pending payment, or is set as the default funding source.

steps.heading: Cancel active subscriptions first
steps.body: Check your PayPal automatic payments and preapproved payments section, and cancel anything still linked to the card before trying to remove it again.

steps.heading: Resolve pending payments or negative balance
steps.body: If there's a pending transaction or a negative PayPal balance, resolve it first, since PayPal may keep the card attached until that's cleared.

steps.heading: Unlink the card from automatic payments
steps.body: Manually go through your list of merchants with preapproved payment access and remove the card as their funding source before deleting it entirely.

faq.question: Why does PayPal say it can't remove my card right now?
faq.answer: This usually happens because the card is tied to an active subscription, a pending payment, or a negative account balance that needs to be resolved first.

faq.question: How do I find subscriptions linked to my PayPal card?
faq.answer: Check the automatic payments or preapproved payments section of your PayPal account settings to see all merchants with access.

faq.question: Can a negative PayPal balance block card removal?
faq.answer: Yes, if your account has a negative balance, PayPal may require the linked card to remain until the balance is settled.

faq.question: What if the card is expired but still won't remove?
faq.answer: Even expired cards can be blocked from removal if they're still attached to an active subscription — cancel the subscription first, then try again.
